readings.Aries: Everyone in the room can feel you deciding. Make the decision. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Taurus: Stubbornness and consistency are the same trait in different lighting. Today, which one is it? The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Gemini: You are more tired than you look. Let someone see it. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Cancer: The boundary you're reluctant to draw is the one you most need. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Leo: Your radiance is not depleted by giving — it's amplified. Give more. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Virgo: The criticism forming in your mind — apply it to the problem, not the person. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Libra: There is something you find beautiful about someone that you haven't told them. Tell them. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Scorpio: The secret you're keeping is protecting someone. Including, in some ways, yourself. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Sagittarius: The fire in you is generative and occasionally destructive. Today, mind the surroundings. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Capricorn: Your patience is a form of power. Today, deploy it on yourself. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Aquarius: The future you're pointing toward is more possible than yesterday. Take one step in its direction. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Pisces: There is a practice — creative, meditative, physical — that has been keeping you whole that you've let lapse. Return to it. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
